svg.title: The two equal normal tails complement the central area
svg.desc: The standard normal density is symmetric about zero. The region below minus one point five and the region above one point five are shaded orange, each with probability approximately zero point zero six six eight. The central interval between minus one point five and one point five is shaded teal and has probability approximately zero point eight six six four. The central probability is one minus twice either tail probability, using unrounded values before the final rounding. Replacing strict boundary inequalities by inclusive ones changes no probability because a continuous normal variable has zero probability at a single value.
